concurrency: initialize() and cleanup() are @MainActor. Access ZMUIToolKitManager from the main thread.
overview: Central all-static setup and management class for the ZMUIToolkit framework. Holds the host's ZoomVideoSDK instance (videoSDK), owns the single SDK delegate slot by installing a CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate fan-out (videoSDKDelegate), manages the connected/cleaned-up lifecycle via initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) and cleanup(), and exposes configuration flags such as cloudRecordingConsentDialogEnabled. Because ZoomVideoSDK.delegate accepts only one delegate, the toolkit centralizes ownership and fans events out to many weakly-held observers. Every self-managing toolkit component relies on this.

typeDefinitions.role: All-static manager. No instances; access via type-level (static) members.

typeDefinitions.name: CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate
typeDefinitions.role: Weak fan-out ZoomVideoSDKDelegate. Register observers via add(_:) / remove(_:). Observers are held weakly.

typeDefinitions.name: ZoomVideoSDK

typeDefinitions.name: Bool
typeDefinitions.relevantValue: initialize return value: true = delegate installed (Initialized), false = SDK not ready (remains Uninitialized).

lifecycle.description: ZMUIToolKitManager connects to an already-initialized ZoomVideoSDK and takes ownership of its delegate slot. It does NOT initialize the SDK itself. initialize must run on the main thread before any toolkit component reads videoSDK; cleanup must run before the host tears the SDK down.
required: Host has an already-initialized ZoomVideoSDK instance.
initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) called on the main thread (@MainActor) before constructing toolkit components that read ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK.
notes: The toolkit does not call ZoomVideoSDK.initialize; it connects to one you provide.
initialize returns Bool; check it. false means the delegate was NOT installed.
There is exactly one fan-out delegate (videoSDKDelegate), created once as a static let and reused for the process lifetime.
Child observers on videoSDKDelegate are held WEAKLY; retain your own observers.
cleanup() does NOT clear registered child observers; they survive across cleanup() / re-initialize(). Deallocated observers are dropped automatically.

actions: acceptance gate: perform an internal SDK usability check; if the SDK cannot be attached, returns false, clears stored references, and the delegate is NOT installed
on success: videoSDK.delegate = videoSDKDelegate; return true
ZMUIToolkitPiPController.shared.stop() — release PiP subscriptions so they do not outlive the session
clear delegate slot when videoSDK != nil AND videoSDK.delegate === videoSDKDelegate (toolkit still owns it)
exitPoints.note: Does NOT clear registered child observers on videoSDKDelegate.

lifecycle.delegateModel: Exactly one fan-out delegate (videoSDKDelegate, a CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate) is installed onto ZoomVideoSDK.delegate by initialize. Integrators and toolkit components add/remove their own ZoomVideoSDKDelegate observers via videoSDKDelegate.add(_:) / remove(_:). Observers are held weakly. Do NOT reassign ZoomVideoSDK.delegate directly.

cleanup.description: Called by the host before destroying the SDK.
cleanup.behavior: Stops Picture-in-Picture, conditionally clears the owned SDK delegate slot, and releases the SDK reference and bundle id.
cleanup.preserves: Registered child observers on videoSDKDelegate are preserved (weakly) so listeners survive across re-initialization.
notes: PiP is stopped here so it does not outlive the session.
Delegate slot is cleared when the toolkit still owns it (=== check); if the host has set a different delegate, it is left as-is.
Idempotent: safe to call when already Uninitialized.

Uninitialized.description: videoSDK == nil and the delegate slot is not owned by the toolkit. Initial state at process start and after cleanup(). Toolkit components constructed in this state construct in a default state and tap actions take no action.
notes: Toolkit components read videoSDK and construct in a default state when nil.
cleanup() is still safe to call (idempotent).

Initialized.description: videoSDK != nil and ZoomVideoSDK.delegate === videoSDKDelegate. Active state after a successful initialize(...) that returned true. Toolkit components are fully functional.
notes: ZoomVideoSDK.delegate is owned by the toolkit; register observers via videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
Calling initialize again re-points the SDK reference and re-installs the delegate; if switching SDK instances, the old owned delegate slot is cleared first.

triggers.stayUninitialized: initialize(...) returns false -> references cleared, delegate NOT installed

notes: Treat initialize's Bool return as authoritative for toolkit delegate attachment, but use the host's ZoomVideoSDK.initialize(...) result to validate SDK initialization.

triggers.toUninitialized: cleanup() -> stops PiP, conditionally clears delegate slot, releases SDK
triggers.rePoint: initialize(...) again -> if switching SDKs, clears the old owned delegate slot, then replaces the SDK ref and re-installs the delegate; existing observers retained

notes: cleanup() does not clear registered observers.

initialize.immediate: Returns Bool synchronously; on true the SDK delegate slot is set before return.

cleanup.immediate: Synchronous; PiP stopped, delegate cleared (if owned), refs nilled before return.

automaticTransitions.none: ZMUIToolKitManager has no SDK-callback-driven automatic state transitions. State changes only via explicit initialize()/cleanup() calls.

initialize.signature: @MainActor @objc static public func initialize(videoSDK: ZoomVideoSDK, bundleId: String?) -> Bool
initialize.description: Connects the toolkit to the host's ZoomVideoSDK instance and installs the toolkit's fan-out delegate onto ZoomVideoSDK.delegate.

parameters.name: videoSDK
parameters.description: The ZoomVideoSDK instance the host initialized and wants the toolkit to observe.

parameters.name: bundleId
parameters.description: Broadcast Upload Extension bundle identifier (used by PiP/broadcast paths); nil is normalized to empty string.

returnValue.meaning: true = videoSDKDelegate installed and the toolkit owns the SDK delegate slot (Initialized). false = the toolkit could not verify delegate ownership after assignment; stored references cleared; delegate NOT installed (remains Uninitialized). Validate SDK initialization separately via the host's ZoomVideoSDK.initialize(...) result.

implicitEffects: If re-pointing from another SDK instance, clears that old delegate slot when still owned by the toolkit.
Stores videoSDK and bundleId (nil -> empty string).
On success, sets videoSDK.delegate = videoSDKDelegate, taking ownership of the SDK delegate slot.
notes: Does NOT call ZoomVideoSDK.initialize; the host remains responsible for SDK initialization.
Treat initialize's Bool return as authoritative when deciding whether toolkit delegate attachment succeeded.
On false, references are fully cleared so calling again is clean.
Call before constructing toolkit components that read ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK.
commonMistakes: Not checking the Bool return value before building UI.
Passing an SDK that the host has not actually initialized successfully.

cleanup.description: Releases the toolkit's hold on the SDK before the host tears the SDK down.

preconditionChecks.validationCode: ZMUIToolKitManager.cleanup() // safe to call even when already Uninitialized

implicitEffects: Calls ZMUIToolkitPiPController.shared.stop() — unsubscribes active PiP video/share sources, retires receivers, flushes the display layer, tears down the AVPictureInPictureController.
Clears ZoomVideoSDK.delegate when the toolkit still owns it (sdk.delegate === videoSDKDelegate).
Sets videoSDK to nil and bundleId to empty string.
Does NOT clear registered child observers on videoSDKDelegate (they survive, held weakly).
notes: PiP is stopped first so it does not outlive the session.
Delegate-slot clearing is conditional on ownership; if the host has set a different delegate, it is left as-is.
Idempotent and safe to call multiple times.
commonMistakes: Expecting cleanup() to remove registered observers (it does not).
Tearing down the SDK before calling cleanup() (leaves PiP holding an SDK pipe).

videoSDK.signature: @objc public static var videoSDK: ZoomVideoSDK? { get }
videoSDK.description: Read-only accessor for the connected SDK instance. nil before initialize and after cleanup. Toolkit components use it to obtain helpers and read session/user state.

preconditionChecks.validationCode: guard let sdk = ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK else { return }

returnValue.meaning: non-nil when Initialized; nil when Uninitialized/cleaned-up.

notes: Read on the main thread.

videoSDKDelegate.description: The single, process-lifetime fan-out delegate. Register observers via videoSDKDelegate.add(_:) / remove via videoSDKDelegate.remove(_:). Only supported way to observe SDK events through the toolkit. Created once; not replaced by cleanup().
notes: Observers are held weakly; retain them yourself.
Survives cleanup()/re-initialize().
commonMistakes: Not retaining the observer (weak storage drops it).
Assigning to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate directly instead of using add(_:).

cloudRecordingConsentDialogEnabled.signature: @objc public static var cloudRecordingConsentDialogEnabled: Bool { get set }
cloudRecordingConsentDialogEnabled.description: Controls whether participants are shown the blocking cloud-recording consent dialog when a recording starts.

returnValue.meaning: true (default) = blocking consent dialog shown; false = dialog suppressed, consent auto-accepted, non-blocking 'Recording started' toast shown instead.

notes: Defaults to true.
When false, consent is auto-accepted and a toast replaces the blocking dialog.
commonMistakes: Setting after a recording's consent dialog has already been presented.

bundleId.description: Internal read-only accessor returning the bundle id supplied to initialize (or empty string). Not part of the public API surface; documented for completeness. Consumed by PiP / broadcast-extension code paths.

returnValue.meaning: Bundle id from initialize, or empty string.

notes: Internal; not public.

CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate.description: Forwards every ZoomVideoSDKDelegate callback to a set of weakly-held child delegates. videoSDKDelegate is an instance of this type.
CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate.storage: Observers held weakly; retain them yourself.
CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate.forwarding: Every ZoomVideoSDKDelegate method is implemented and forwards to each live child via the optional-method form ($0.method?(...)), so observers only implement the callbacks they care about.
CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate.threading: Callbacks delivered on whatever thread the SDK invokes them (main thread for UI-relevant events); the composite does not hop threads.

callbacks.note: ZMUIToolKitManager itself does not implement ZoomVideoSDKDelegate callbacks. It owns videoSDKDelegate (CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate), which receives all SDK callbacks and forwards them to weakly-held observers registered via add(_:). See ownedType.CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate for the forwarded surface.

required: Call initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) on the main thread, with an already-initialized SDK, before constructing toolkit components.
Check the Bool return value of initialize. false means the delegate was not installed and toolkit components will not receive events.
Call cleanup() on the main thread before tearing the SDK down (it releases PiP, which holds an SDK delegate/pipe that must not outlive the session).
Observe SDK events via videoSDKDelegate.add(_:); retain your observer (held weakly).
forbidden: Assigning anything directly to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate after initialize; the toolkit owns that slot. Register observers via videoSDKDelegate.add(_:). Reassigning the slot stops cleanup from clearing it (the === ownership check no longer matches).
Relying on cleanup() to clear your observers; they persist across re-initialize().

invariants.rule: videoSDKDelegate is a single static let created once.
invariants.implication: It is never replaced; cleanup() does not recreate or clear it.

invariants.rule: cleanup() clears ZoomVideoSDK.delegate only when sdk.delegate === videoSDKDelegate.
invariants.implication: If a third party set a different delegate, cleanup leaves it as-is.

invariants.rule: initialize fully clears stored references when it returns false.
invariants.implication: A false return leaves the manager cleanly Uninitialized; calling again is clean.

errorHandling.description: ZMUIToolKitManager does not return SDK error codes. The only fallible operation is initialize, which signals failure via a Bool. cleanup is void and idempotent.

initialize.meaning: videoSDKDelegate installed; toolkit owns the SDK delegate slot; state is Initialized.
The toolkit could not verify delegate ownership after assignment. Stored references cleared; delegate NOT installed.
allowed: Verify you passed the live host SDK instance
Call initialize again once the host lifecycle/setup issue has been corrected
initialize.retry: Call initialize again once the host lifecycle/setup issue has been resolved; references are already cleared so calling again is clean.

cleanup.retry: No retry concept; safe to repeat.

byErrorCode.initialize_false: Do not blindly retry; ensure you passed the live host SDK instance and that host setup completed successfully, then call initialize again.
